name: How much does drywall texture repair cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall texture repair cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of drywall texture repair in the Bay Area varies significantly based on factors such as the extent of the damage, the type of texture, the size of the area needing repair, and the complexity of the job. Minor patch repairs might start a few hundred dollars, while larger or more intricate texture matching projects can be considerably more. It's recommended to get a detailed estimate from a local contractor for an accurate price.
